<script>
function bcHighlightMicRow() {
  var id = window.location.hash ? window.location.hash.substring(1) : "";
  if (!id) return;
  var row = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!row) return;
  row.classList.add("openmic-highlight");
  row.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  setTimeout(function() { row.classList.remove("openmic-highlight"); }, 4000);
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", bcHighlightMicRow);
window.addEventListener("hashchange", bcHighlightMicRow);

function bcFilterOpenMics() {
  var query = document.getElementById("openmic-search").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll("table.openmic-table tbody tr");
  var visibleCount = 0;
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var match = row.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1;
    row.style.display = match ? "" : "none";
    if (match) visibleCount++;
  });
  var noResults = document.getElementById("openmic-no-results");
  if (noResults) {
    noResults.style.display = (rows.length > 0 && visibleCount === 0) ? "block" : "none";
  }
}
</script>
